feedback.issue: Multiple validation patterns scattered throughout orchestrator (validateConfig at lines 187-227, inline timeout validation). Could benefit from consolidation.
feedback.suggestion: Extract common validation patterns into utility functions (e.g., validateTimeouts(), validateMode()) to reduce code duplication and improve maintainability. Consider creating a ValidationUtils module.

feedback.issue: Current logging uses plain console output. In large-scale deployments with many concurrent agents, unstructured logs become difficult to parse and analyze.
feedback.suggestion: Implement structured JSON logging for orchestrator state transitions and agent lifecycle events. Maintain human-readable logs but add machine-parseable JSON format alongside.

feedback.issue: Generic Error types used throughout (Error instanceof Error checks). Specific error scenarios (GateFailure, ConsensusFailure, TimeoutError) use same error type.
feedback.suggestion: Create custom error classes: GateCheckError, ConsensusValidationError, AgentTimeoutError, ProductOwnerExecutionError. Enables targeted error recovery strategies and better error diagnostics.

feedback.issue: [RESOLVED] Iteration 1 had unescaped shell arguments passed to execSync().
feedback.suggestion: escapeShellArg() function properly implemented (line 159) and consistently applied throughout. Shell injection vulnerability completely eliminated. No further action needed.

feedback.issue: [RESOLVED] CVSS 9.1/10 vulnerability: Redis password mismatch between docker-compose.yml files.
feedback.suggestion: Fixed via standardization to REDIS_PASSWORD variable. Both docker-compose.yml and docker/docker-compose.yml now use same source. Validated by test-redis-password-consistency.sh (3/3 passing).

feedback.issue: [PARTIALLY RESOLVED] 2 scripts still missing Pattern B (.parameter set) implementation: execute-lifecycle-hook.sh, simple-audit.sh.
feedback.suggestion: Refactor remaining scripts to use sqlite3 .parameter set pattern instead of string concatenation. Complete Pattern B rollout across all SQL operations to achieve 100% coverage (currently 71% → target 100%).

feedback.issue: [RESOLVED] Iteration 1 had TypeScript compilation errors preventing execution.
feedback.suggestion: All types properly defined, interfaces well-designed, validation comprehensive. Zero compilation errors. Type guards implemented (isValidExecutionMode, isValidProductOwnerDecision). No further improvements needed.

feedback.issue: Timeout validation happens at construction time. Dynamic timeout adjustments during long-running orchestrations would require recreating Orchestrator instance.
feedback.suggestion: Add methods: updateTimeout(type, newValue), getTimeoutsForPhase(phase) to support dynamic adjustment. Useful for long orchestrations with varying phase durations.

feedback.issue: Task IDs accepted with any content. Could allow problematic characters in Redis keys or file paths.
feedback.suggestion: Validate Task IDs against whitelist pattern (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores). Prevents issues with Redis key escaping and file path handling. Pattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$

feedback.issue: [RESOLVED] Iteration 1 had incomplete ITERATE workflow - feedback mechanism not implemented.
feedback.suggestion: Feedback properly stored in Redis, includes metrics (passRate, consensusAverage, gap analysis), tracks failed agents, includes reasons. Multiple iteration support fully functional with state reset between iterations.

feedback.issue: Feedback stored per iteration but no historical trend analysis. Cannot detect convergence patterns or oscillation.
feedback.suggestion: Extend IterationFeedback to include: previousIterationMetrics, trendAnalysis (improving/degrading/oscillating), convergenceEstimate. Helps Product Owner detect stuck loops early.

feedback.issue: [RESOLVED] Iteration 1: Product Owner timeout caused orchestration hangs. Default was 30s (too short for complex analysis).
feedback.suggestion: Timeout configurable per mode (MVP: 45s, Standard: 60s, Enterprise: 90s). Increased default to 60s with rationale documented. Timeout validation ensures 10-600s range (execute-decision.sh lines 80-96).

feedback.issue: Multiple parsing strategies used (JSON first, plain text fallback, case-insensitive fallback). Good defensive programming but indicates format inconsistency.
feedback.suggestion: Standardize Product Owner output format to always use JSON structure. Current fallbacks handle legacy outputs - consider deprecation timeline and enforce JSON format in future iterations.

feedback.issue: Deliverable check only looks for git status changes. Could miss refactoring-only commits or architectural changes without file additions.
feedback.suggestion: Enhance verification: check for code size changes (not just file count), validate commit messages, inspect actual implementation not just presence. Prevents 'consensus on plans' anti-pattern.

feedback.issue: [RESOLVED] Code quality tests all passing: 57/57 (100%). Security tests: 16/16 (100%). Gate status: PASSES.
feedback.suggestion: Test coverage exceeds 95% target for Iteration 2. Comprehensive validation of all fixed issues. No further test improvements needed before Loop 2 validator phase.

feedback.issue: Unit tests comprehensive but Docker integration tests pending. Real orchestrator-coordinator handoffs not yet validated.
feedback.suggestion: Add end-to-end tests: orchestrator spawn → Loop 3 agents complete → gate check → Loop 2 validators → consensus → Product Owner decision → orchestration complete. Validates full workflow.

feedback.issue: Type definitions and function signatures well-documented but implementation logic sometimes lacks inline comments explaining why over what.
feedback.suggestion: Add 'why' comments for complex logic: gate check thresholds, consensus calculation, iteration reset cleanup. Helps future maintainers understand design decisions.

feedback.issue: Orchestrator class is large (1,337 lines). Single-responsibility concerns mixed (phase management, agent tracking, timeout handling).
feedback.suggestion: Consider extracting responsibilities: OrchestrationState manager, AgentTracker, TimeoutManager, FeedbackCollector. Improves testability and reduces class complexity while maintaining same functionality.

critical_issues_resolved: TypeScript compilation errors (type definitions and validation)
